name: podcast-studio
description: Produce a podcast episode from the host and guest recordings: automatic track alignment, cuts applied to every track at once, noise reduction, two-pass loudness normalisation to -16 LUFS (or your target), intro and outro, export to MP3/WAV, plus a project you can reopen and edit. Waveform panel with drag-to-cut and preview. Runs locally with the ffmpeg on your computer; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Produce a podcast episode from the host and guest recordings: automatic track alignment, cuts applied to every track at once, noise reduction, two-pass loudness normalisation to -16 LUFS (or your target), intro and outro, export to MP3/WAV, plus a project you can reopen and edit. Waveform panel with drag-to-cut and preview. Runs locally with the ffmpeg on your computer; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用主持人和嘉宾的录音制作一期播客：自动对齐音轨，所有音轨同步剪辑，降噪，两遍响度统一到 -16 LUFS（或自定目标），加片头片尾，导出 MP3/WAV，并保存可以再次打开修改的工程。面板显示波形，拖动即可剪掉一段，并可试听。在本地用电脑上的 ffmpeg 运行，无需 API 密钥。

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg 路径（可选）
ffmpegPath.description: 可选。ffmpeg 可执行文件的完整路径。默认在 PATH 和 /opt/homebrew/bin、/usr/local/bin 中查找。
